scenes.title: The lending growth decision
caption_lines: Compare approval policies across profit, credit losses and cash.
10,000 synthetic applications; a common 39-month runoff horizon.

scenes.title: Profit alone cannot determine feasible growth
caption_lines: Aggressive earns about $396k, but minimum cash falls to -$1.49m.
Conservative meets the base limits: about $48k profit and $147k minimum cash.

scenes.title: More capital changes the recommendation
caption_lines: Starting equity of $1.25m makes Balanced eligible and recommended.
Profit stays about $294k; minimum cash reaches $54k. Equity has no modeled financing cost.

scenes.title: Stress can remove the profitable recommendation
caption_lines: At 2x lifetime defaults, Conservative loses about $11.6k.
It is a diagnostic only: no eligible policy produces positive operating profit.

scenes.title: Check the financial mechanics
caption_lines: Loan, debt, cash, cohort and simplified-equity schedules reconcile.
Principal collections are not revenue; charge-offs are not a second cash payment.

scenes.title: Leave a reproducible decision brief
caption_lines: The brief records the recommendation, policy tradeoffs and applied inputs.
Open the live app or saved briefs for deeper review. Historical calibration is unavailable.
